name: Icehide 76555 can be skinned (COA-7138)
contract: Requires CoALegendaryItems.DropChance=0: this scenario checks skinning an otherwise empty corpse.
Icehide 76555 is a level 14 elite cat beast with no skinning table, so its corpse could never be skinned.
It now uses the level 10-15 leather table 100015. Icehide has no creature loot or money, so its corpse is
skinnable as soon as it dies, and Skinning 75 opens a skinning loot window on it.

steps.label: The skinning loot window opens on Icehide
